# Learned instinct: pci-audit-log-protection (confidence 0.97)

Audit logs must be protected from unauthorized modification and destruction. Any Ansible task that disables, truncates, or modifies syslog, auditd, log rotation, or SIEM forwarding on a PCI-scope system is a CRITICAL finding. The governance ledger must be append-only; the siem-forwarder ships events to the external SIEM where they cannot be modified by the agent.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 10.3 — protect audit logs
